title: 0l4q reconciliation: rework 6 rpl_stack test fixtures to the canonical-multicast DIO admission contract
description: Follow-up from 0l4q bisection+diagnosis (worker-6, released at timebox). Root cause chain: admission was deliberately tightened to the canonical multicast DIO contract (85a1f1d218 'DIO admission requires multicast dst ff02::1a' matching Python authenticated_dio.py:359-360; partially reconciled by 3d104a10cd 'admit unicast-delivered multicast DIOs'), introduced to main in the 5beefd7b295..48940e0975 sync window (bisected). The six failing tests predate the contract and deliver DIOs in ways admission now rejects. Per-test plan: (1) leaf_send_allocates_each_update_and_restart_advances_sequence / relay_forwards_original_source_and_signed_body / three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent / dao_radio_failure_retains_exact_finalized_bytes — these use join_leaf/dio_packet_from with UNICAST leaf-addressed DIOs (dio_packet_from(root, leaf_link_local,...) via send_ipv6_to); rework delivery to canonical multicast (dst ff02::1a, broadcast L2 AddrMode::None, Rule 255 uncompressed, hop 255 — multicast_dio_and_dis_use_broadcast_l2_destination shows root.send_dio(multicast) already does this correctly) or re-pin expectations where unicast-admission was the asserted contract (no longer exists per R-09-005). (2) multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received — first multicast receive+join PASSES; the invalid-options loop (dio_packet_with_raw_version_options, tests.rs:~1099) fails: reconcile the inconsistent-DioReceived expectations with Rule-255 admission requirements. (3) rpl_dispatch_rejects_invalid_ipv6_length_and_checksum — re-verify which rejection stage the malformed cases now hit. The production admission code is SPEC-CORRECT (Python parity) — fix fixtures, not admission. Useful helper: root.send_dio(multicast) emits the canonical wire shape; leaf-side LoopbackRadio pair delivery already proven in the passing first half of multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received.
close_reason: RESOLVED (worker-4, same work as 0l4q which closed with full evidence): the 6 rpl_stack fixture failures were fixed by reworking join_leaf to canonical multicast DIO delivery (79b2b87b76) and adapting three_rpl_stacks/multicast_dio_and_dis to option A multicast solicited responses + root DIO-echo draining (a24a9e2e90). lichen-node lib 307/307 green verified repeatedly before the repo-wide oscore compile break (zhm8) landed. This reconciliation bead's per-test plan is fully executed; the implemented contract is option A (multicast-only solicited response). No remaining fixture work — rust lib test re-run is blocked only by zhm8's oscore merge artifact, not by any fixture.
